name: rating
description: Overall rating of the research brief, 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Added 2026-09-14 alongside the rating on ResearchFeedbackRequest; NULL on rows written before it existed, and on any future row submitted without one.

name: created_at
description: Insert time. Added 2026-09-11: this table is DAY-partitioned on this column in Terraform (terraform/2-foundations), so it must always be populated - a NULL would land the row in the __NULL__ partition, escaping both partition pruning and any future expiry policy.
